nodes.title: MCP revision 2026-07-28 EXISTS (GA 2026-07-28); headers real; sessions removed
nodes.summary: Spec dir + GA release tag (2026-07-28T16:47:49Z; RC 2026-05-29). Mcp-Method (all requests), Mcp-Name (tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get), Mcp-Param-{Name} via x-mcp-header (int/string/bool only) are REQUIRED (SEP-2243). MRTR: InputRequiredResult resultType=input_required with inputRequests/inputResponses (SEP-2322). Origin MUST validate -> 403. Closing SSE response stream = cancellation. DIFFERS from PDF1: protocol sessions/Mcp-Session-Id, initialize handshake and SSE resumability (Last-Event-ID) are REMOVED (SEP-2567, SEP-2575); CR/LF prohibition applies to x-mcp-header annotation NAME, header VALUES with control chars are base64-sentinel encoded not rejected.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Spec is new (3 months); SDK/client adoption unmeasured here
nodes.underclaim_risk: Treating whole PDF1 MCP description as invented would be wrong; core is accurate

nodes.title: AIP = Agent Identity Protocol arXiv 2603.24775 EXISTS; PDF1 latency figures partly wrong
nodes.summary: Sunil Prakash, 2026-03-25, v1 only, cs.CR, single-author preprint, github.com/sunilp/aip, Apple M3 Max. MATCH: compact 0.049 ms Rust / 0.189 ms Python; +0.22 ms real MCP HTTP overhead; 340-380 B per block; X-AIP-Token header; max_depth default 3; chained mode = Biscuit. NOT FOUND: '135 us 3-hop' and '324 us 6-hop'; paper reports Rust chained verify depth3=0.516 ms, depth5=0.745 ms (Python 0.315/0.447), max depth tested 5. PDF1 gate '<300 us depth-5' contradicts paper. crates.io 'aip' = unrelated Google AIP-160/193 crate (aip-rs).

nodes.title: wasmtime #13467 EXISTS: an ISSUE (question), not PR/design
nodes.summary: 'How to limit guest code execution rate?' by matthew-a-thomas, opened 2026-05-23, closed 2026-08-25, 8 comments. Hobbyist question; maintainers (cfallin, fitzgen) advise wallclock-based combinator using fuel/epochs only to regain control; no endorsed fuel-rate API. Does not support PDF1's epoch_deadline_callback recipe as an established pattern.

nodes.title: x402 '165M transactions' NOT FOUND in any primary source; figures vary 75M-200M+ with heavy wash caveats
nodes.summary: x402.org widget (fetched 2026-10-24): last-30-days 75.41M tx, $24.24M volume, 94.06K buyers, 22K sellers; identical values appear in Wayback snapshots dated 2026-03-02 and 2026-06-06, so widget may be static/stale. Visa (Sheffield)/Artemis adjusted: ~$19M, ~134M tx since May 2025 (data as of 2026-04-21, excludes wash/test). Artemis: wash avg 63.94% of tx 2025-11-09..2026-02-07, peak 90.21%; top 1% buyers (~4,000 wallets) = ~90% adjusted volume. Major Matters tracker >200M raw (June 2026), Artemis: >95% protocol signaling. Chainalysis: >138M Base tx, 87% < $0.10. gitbook FAQ cited by PDF1 contains no such number.
